name: Bisichi PLC
summary: Bisichi PLC engages in coal mining activities in the United Kingdom and South Africa. The company owns an interest in the Black Wattle Colliery located in South Africa. It also engages in the share dealing and retail property investment activities, as well as residential property development activity. The company was formerly known as Bisichi Mining Plc and changed its name to Bisichi PLC in March 2020. Bisichi PLC was incorporated in 1910 and is based in London, the United Kingdom.
